answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring collateral to validate transactions, making it impossible to forge identities without capital. Just as a canyon restricts the flow of a river to a narrow path, the economic cost of staked assets forces agents to incur real financial risk, rendering the mass creation of fake accounts prohibitively expensive and economically irrational for any malicious actor attempting to subvert the network consensus.
